video_title: "We Were Together The Day We Won": RJ On The 2016 Cavs Reunion

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the 2016 Cavaliers team chemistry
quotes.excerpt: Every activity we did, 99 percent of it was us together all the time.
quotes.quote: Every activity we did, 99 percent of it was us together all the time. All you see here is the laughing and the joking and the dancing. We were around each other 15 to 16 hours a day, all day, every day. There was never a time where I was getting tired of these guys.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye and Matthew Dellavedova's energy impact on the 2016 Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: Delli and Chump coming and injecting some energy into the group was great.
quotes.quote: Delli and Chump coming and injecting some energy into the group was great. I think golfing was amazing. If I hear any more yacht house, I think my ears are going to bleed. But we just, it was the best of the best of the best. There was nothing I would have changed.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the team's social atmosphere during the 2016 championship
quotes.excerpt: There wasn't a TV on one time. Everyone was just laughing, drinking, chilling.
quotes.quote: There wasn't a TV on one time. Everyone was just laughing, drinking, chilling. It was cool to kind of relive because all of social was talking about the 10-year anniversary of it, and then our group got together, so that just added some more fun. All of us still talk 10 years later, and half the guys are retired and moved on.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the annoyance of teammates working out
quotes.excerpt: The most annoying part was Delli and Bron waking up to work out every day.
quotes.quote: The most annoying part was Delli and Bron waking up to work out every day. That was the most annoying part. It's like, really, you are going to go work out?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Matthew Dellavedova's physical transformation
quotes.excerpt: Delli is the most shredded dude right now. It's disgusting.
quotes.quote: Delli is the most shredded dude right now. It's disgusting. Delli looks like he's gained 10, 15 pounds. We were like, Delli, did you get taller? What the fuck? He is yoked up. He is yoked up, ready for his league. It's crazy. I was shocked.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the team's excessive order of Aperol Spritzes
quotes.excerpt: There was a guy making our Aperol Spritz for about two hours straight.
quotes.quote: When you order an Aperol Spritz, they just give you the glass. So we said, hey, there's a bunch of us, can we get like 20? Which isn't that big a deal, right? There was a guy making our Aperol Spritz for about two hours straight. We were crushing them.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on the fitness levels of Matthew Dellavedova and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Delli and Bron are still very much into fitness.
quotes.quote: Delli and Bron are still very much into fitness. Good for them.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on Kevin Love's golf game
quotes.excerpt: Kevin got good. I think Kevin shot an 82 at Skibo.
quotes.quote: Kevin got good. I think Kevin shot an 82 at Skibo. But he had some days where he was bad, and then all of a sudden, he got really good. He was hot in the beginning, slowed down in the middle, got hot again at the end.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on LeBron James's improvement as a golfer
quotes.excerpt: Most improved goes to Bron though. He was so trash at the beginning.
quotes.quote: Most improved goes to Bron though. He was so trash at the beginning of watching him play and posting clips, and literally by the end, it was, bro, you almost look like a golfer. You almost look like you know. No, I'm being serious. He's in the sand, he chips out, he one-putts, and you're like, the fuck is going on here?

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on LeBron James and Kevin Love's approach to golf
quotes.excerpt: Bron and Kevin are the same way where it's like, the minute they pick it up, they're like, all of a sudden become fucking scientists.
quotes.quote: Bron and Kevin are the same way where it's like, the minute they pick it up, they're like, all of a sudden become fucking scientists and just being like, okay, hey, do I do this? Or how does this look? And it was just like, these dudes were just so locked in.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the composition of the 2016 Cavaliers group chat
quotes.excerpt: There's like six of us. It was JR, Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Channing, and Bron.
quotes.quote: There's like six of us. It was JR, Swish, Tristan, Kevin, Channing, and Bron. So that's the group of us. Then we start doing, hey guys, we should get together, do some golf and go do this. And then a conversation kind of got started is, and like, hey, it would be wrong if we didn't invite some of the other guys because it's going to look like we're calling it this championship. No, it was the group chat from the championship team, not the championship team group chat.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the inclusion of teammates in the reunion
quotes.excerpt: Delli and Shump came over after the finals.
quotes.quote: Delli and Shump came over after the finals and all that stuff. So we love all the people involved. We love our guy Kyrie. Jordan McRae was commenting on everything. You know, so it's nothing but love. It's amazing how you can give everybody everything and they're like, well where's this? Where's that?
